primary_source.finding: Masked matching returns through matchTemplateMask before the UMat/OpenCL dispatch. An unmasked projection experiment does not replace the masked final verifier.

inputs: Two public reference-video bars,32 compatible templates each, three interleaved rounds per backend. Original ProjectionScreen.possible decisions compared exactly; includes input setup/result download.
decision: Keep production backend unchanged. Both inputs preserve decisions, but first OpenCL-requested calls take about3.6/9.1 seconds; warm results are18.8–19.5ms versus9.3–9.5ms for the smaller bar,26.9–30.9ms versus32.3ms for the larger bar. These mixed gains and initialization cost do not justify a default switch.
next: Evaluate mature native matcher candidates with exact mask/score behavior and bounded real-client fixtures; do not repeat the same thread or UMat microbenchmark without new evidence.
